limitations: Screen capture was stopped at the user request. Final native armor/body transforms and retained gun layers were compiled but not visually rechecked; no final-build client startup is claimed.
The earlier timed-search screen was observed in the isolated client. Those earlier captures do not validate the final renderer.
Uncovered military heads use a stable default Minecraft skin; the torso reuses the original uniform sleeve UVs. This is an implementation approximation, not a verified video texture match.
Shared looting and In Control player scaling use two server FakePlayers, not two connected clients.
Natural spawn caps count loaded entities in the Overworld and scale by player count; the independent SEM cap of 18 hostile east/west soldiers across loaded and unloaded chunks remains in force.
No long-term corpse population or multiplayer load test. Spawn caps, issue quantities and search timings are pack balance choices, not confirmed video values.
The live Prism client and existing live worlds were not started or modified. GitHub release artifacts were not published.
